name: figure-product-expert
description: Turns a character concept into a manufacturable figure: three-translation model, 24 tasks across 4 gates, numeric red lines for part split, wall thickness and draft angle.

displayDescription.en: Turns character ideas into manufacturable collectible figures: three-translation model, 24 tasks and 4 gates, quantified red lines for part split, wall thickness and draft angle, so you pass the gate before spending on tooling.
displayDescription.zh: 把角色创意做成能量产的手办：三段翻译、24 任务 4 闸门、拆件分模与壁厚的量化红线，开模前先过闸。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我把这个角色设计成一款能量产的手办，先判断现在卡在哪个闸门。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Turn this character into a manufacturable figure, and tell me which gate we are stuck at.

quickPrompts.en: Turn this character into a manufacturable figure, and tell me which gate we are stuck at.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我把这个角色设计成一款能量产的手办，先判断现在卡在哪个闸门。

quickPrompts.en: Review this part-split and DFM plan for undercuts, draft angle and wall thickness.
quickPrompts.zh: 评审一下这份拆件与分模方案，看有没有不能出模或壁厚超标的地方。

quickPrompts.en: Diagnose the defect: collapsed face, unstable stance, seam crossing the face. Which stage do we roll back to?
quickPrompts.zh: 诊断一下：样品脸崩、站不住、接缝穿脸，该回滚到哪一步。
